nodes.title: Guide: Purpose and use
widgets_values:
# Prompt builder

## Purpose
Compose a structured prompt and organize reference media before reference-guided generation.

## Use
1. Load reference media and fill in the prompt-builder fields.
2. Review the assembled prompt and reference selections.
3. Set generation size and duration, then run and inspect the result.

Workflow: PDD-Acc-r2v-prompt-builder-pod.json
